Name: OrderRatios
SQL:
-- sgl.query(OrderRatios, one)
SELECT quantity / 3 AS per_third,
       unit_price / quantity AS unit_share,
       weight / 2 AS half_weight,
       quantity DIV 2 AS halves,
       flags & 4 AS masked,
       flags << 1 AS shifted
FROM orders
WHERE id = ?;
Template:
SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:quantity / 3⟩ AS per_third,
       ⟨c1 aliased:unit_price / quantity⟩ AS unit_share,
       ⟨c2 aliased:weight / 2⟩ AS half_weight,
       ⟨c3 aliased:quantity DIV 2⟩ AS halves,
       ⟨c4 aliased:flags & 4⟩ AS masked,
       ⟨c5 aliased:flags << 1⟩ AS shifted
FROM orders
WHERE id = ⟨p0⟩;⟨arguments p0⟩

Name: OrderLabels
SQL:
-- sgl.query(OrderLabels, many)
SELECT CONCAT_WS(',', note, label) AS joined,
       CONCAT_WS(separator_text, label) AS by_separator
FROM orders;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:CONCAT_WS(',', note, label)⟩ AS joined,\n       ⟨c1 aliased:CONCAT_WS(separator_text, label)⟩ AS by_separator\nFROM orders;

Name: OrderDetails
SQL:
-- sgl.query(OrderDetails, many)
SELECT details -> '$.colour' AS colour_json,
       details ->> '$.colour' AS colour
FROM orders;
Template: SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:details -> '$.colour'⟩ AS colour_json,\n       ⟨c1 aliased:details ->> '$.colour'⟩ AS colour\nFROM orders;

Name: BusyOrders
Template: SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩, ⟨c1 aliased:quantity > 1 || flags > 0⟩ AS busy\nFROM orders;
